records.title: Genetic Ablation of p16<sup>INK4a</sup> Does Not Protect against Cellular Senescence in Mouse Models of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease/Emphysema.
records.model: Global or lung epithelial p16 knockout mice with cigarette-smoke or elastase COPD models
records.note: Deleting p16 failed to protect inflammation, lung function or airspace structure, and senescence staining still increased; this tests gene deletion, not selective clearance of senescent cells.
records.uncertainty: No restorative administered drug; abstract wording about removal of p16-positive cells should not be equated with senolysis.

records.title: Myoblast replication is reduced in the IUGR fetus despite maintained proliferative capacity in vitro.
records.model: Placental-insufficiency IUGR fetal sheep and isolated myoblast cultures
records.note: IUGR reduced muscle weight and in vivo myoblast proliferation, but isolated myoblasts retained dose- and time-dependent insulin responsiveness in enriched culture.
records.uncertainty: No administered fetal treatment, recovered muscle mass or contractile function is demonstrated.

records.title: Zebrafish Models for Skeletal Muscle Senescence: Lessons from Cell Cultures and Rodent Models.
records.model: Review of muscle senescence models, including zebrafish, rodents and cultured cells
records.note: Surveys models for skeletal-muscle senescence and their experimental strengths; the abstract supplies no new administered intervention efficacy result.
records.uncertainty: Review-level discussion cannot establish a drug effect.

records.title: Cdkn1b overexpression in adult mice alters the balance between genome and tissue ageing.
records.model: Inducible Cdkn1b/p27-overexpressing adult and neonatal mice
records.note: Adult p27 induction reduced proliferation and caused tissue ageing phenotypes without more DNA damage or cellular senescence; neonatal induction stunted growth and postponed degeneration.
records.uncertainty: Doxycycline is the transgene trigger, not an anti-ageing treatment being validated.

records.title: Senescent intervertebral disc cells exhibit perturbed matrix homeostasis phenotype.
records.model: Ercc1-deficient progeroid mouse discs and cultured human intervertebral-disc cells
records.note: Senescent discs lost proteoglycan, while peroxide-induced human disc senescence lowered matrix synthesis and increased inflammatory and aggrecan-degrading activity.
records.uncertainty: No compound rescue or muscle-function experiment is reported.

records.title: A Reassessment of Genes Modulating Aging in Mice Using Demographic Measurements of the Rate of Aging.
records.model: Demographic reanalysis of mouse longevity and accelerated-ageing genetic studies
records.note: Gompertz analysis separated lifespan shifts from ageing-rate changes; Cisd2 and hMTH1 were the only two of thirty longevity genes with significant ageing-rate reduction.
records.uncertainty: Cross-study genetic demographic analysis, not an administered-drug trial; control survival can alter conclusions.

records.title: Mouse Models of Accelerated Cellular Senescence.
records.model: Mouse models and methods for accelerated cellular senescence
records.note: Discusses detecting senescence burden and the limitations of individual markers, with general reference to genetic or pharmacological clearance.
records.uncertainty: No named new drug regimen or efficacy experiment appears in the abstract.

records.title: Combination Treatment of OSI-906 with Aurora B Inhibitor Reduces Cell Viability via Cyclin B1 Degradation-Induced Mitotic Slippage.

agent_roles.role: Aurora-B inhibitor; combination causes mitotic defects

records.model: Cultured cancer-related cell experiments; line unspecified in saved abstract
records.note: Combined OSI-906 and ZM447439 caused chromosome-alignment defects, precocious cyclin-B1 loss, mitotic slippage and cytokinesis failure with reduced viability.
records.uncertainty: This is chromosome-instability induction for cancer killing, not healthy-tissue compensation; dose and exact cell line require primary text.

records.title: Sarcopenia and cachexia: molecular mechanisms and therapeutic interventions.
records.model: Review of sarcopenia and cachexia mechanisms and interventions
records.note: Compares age-associated and illness-associated muscle wasting and surveys treatment categories without a named new administered efficacy result.
records.uncertainty: Broad intervention discussion does not establish tissue or functional benefit for a specific drug.

records.title: KIF18A inhibitor prevents chromosomally unstable osteosarcoma growth by activating spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Whole-genome-doubled SJSA1 derivatives, U2OS/MG63 osteosarcoma cells and nude-mouse xenografts
records.note: KIF18A loss and AM-1882 impaired chromosomally unstable osteosarcoma growth through spindle defects and checkpoint-dependent mitotic delay.
records.uncertainty: Abstract claims low toxicity but gives no dose or normal-muscle functional testing; SAC activation is not evidence of BUBR1 restoration.

records.title: Cell enlargement causes mitotic errors and aneuploidy in cells that evade senescence after CDK4/6 inhibition
records.model: Cells that re-enter the cycle after CDK4/6 inhibition, including p53-null context
records.note: Enlargement during CDK4/6 inhibition weakened the checkpoint and cohesion; constraining cell size prevented mitotic defects, and restoring cohesion reduced segregation errors.
records.uncertainty: Preprint abstract does not name the inhibitor or how size was constrained; cannot infer a restorative drug regimen.

records.title: NAD<sup>+</sup> Repletion Rescues Female Fertility during Reproductive Aging.
records.model: Aged female mammals, oocytes and developing embryos; SIRT2 transgenic comparison
records.note: NMN restored age-impaired oocyte quality and fertility, with embryo developmental benefit; SIRT2 overexpression reproduced benefit although SIRT2 deletion did not impair oocyte quality.
records.uncertainty: Known NMN/SIRT2 route; no dose, muscle function or BUB1B-deficient model in this abstract.

records.title: Senomorphic activity of a combination of niacinamide and hyaluronic acid: correlation with clinical improvement of skin aging.
records.model: Human skin explants; forty-four-woman cosmetic trial and thirty-woman paired-arm biopsy study
records.note: Two-month combined skin formula improved cosmetic measures and reduced several SASP-associated transcripts, with more collagen and glycosaminoglycan in explants.
records.uncertainty: Cannot separate component effects or equate topical niacinamide with systemic niacin-mediated BUBR1 restoration; muscle outcomes untested.

records.title: Rae1 is an essential mitotic checkpoint regulator that cooperates with Bub3 to prevent chromosome missegregation.
records.model: Rae1/Bub3 knockout and haploinsufficient mice and derived cells
records.note: Rae1 overexpression corrected mitotic defects from Rae1 or Bub3 haploinsufficiency; combined haploinsufficiency worsened segregation and carcinogen-associated tumor susceptibility.
records.uncertainty: Genetic compensation, not an administered restorative molecule or a BUB1B model.

records.title: Sequestration of CDH1 by MAD2L2 prevents premature APC/C activation prior to anaphase onset.
records.model: Human cell MAD2L2 loss experiments
records.note: MAD2L2 normally sequestered CDH1 until anaphase; its loss advanced APC/C substrate destruction and caused accelerated, aberrant mitosis.
records.uncertainty: No administered rescue compound is reported.

records.title: Chk2 prevents mitotic exit when the majority of kinetochores are unattached.
records.model: Chk2-deficient cultured cells and phosphomimetic Aurora-B complementation
records.note: Chk2 supported Mps1 stability and Aurora-B S331 phosphorylation when many kinetochores were unattached; S331E Aurora B restored alignment or segregation after Chk2 loss.
records.uncertainty: The rescue is genetic Aurora-B activation, not Aurora inhibition or a BUBR1-deficient drug rescue.

records.title: Survivin safeguards chromosome numbers and protects from aneuploidy independently from p53.
records.model: HCT116, SBC-2 and U87-MG with Survivin knockdown and matched p53 loss
records.note: Survivin depletion produced polyploidy, merotelic attachments and DNA damage regardless of p53; p53-dependent arrest did not prevent chromosome instability.
records.uncertainty: DDR inhibition altered p21 induction, not a demonstrated fidelity rescue; no restorative intervention.

records.title: Usp7 protects genomic stability by regulating Bub3.
records.model: USP7-depleted or inhibitor-treated cells; NCI-60 expression correlation
records.note: USP7 depletion and inhibitors caused mitotic abnormalities; Bub3 was identified as a USP7 partner/substrate linking deubiquitination to checkpoint stability.
records.uncertainty: The abstract provides no named agent or rescue regimen; USP7 inhibition is counterevidence for fidelity restoration.

records.title: Mps1 kinase-dependent Sgo2 centromere localisation mediates cohesin protection in mouse oocyte meiosis I.
records.model: Mouse oocyte meiosis I with Mps1 inhibition or Bub1 kinase loss
records.note: Mps1 inhibition impaired centromeric cohesion protection, whereas Bub1 kinase loss was tolerated when Mps1 remained functional; Sgo2 position explained the distinction.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic disruption of meiosis, not a beneficial administered intervention.

records.title: Aurora B prevents premature removal of spindle assembly checkpoint proteins from the kinetochore: A key role for Aurora B in mitosis.
records.model: Kinetochore-tethered MPS1 experiments and breast/colon cancer cell panels
records.note: Aurora-B inhibition removed checkpoint proteins from attached kinetochores and synergized with MPS1 inhibition to silence the checkpoint and kill cancer cells.
records.uncertainty: No healthy-tissue rescue is established; nocodazole pre-arrest changes the drug interaction.

records.title: Rejuvenation: Turning Back Time by Enhancing CISD2.
records.model: Review of CISD2 genetics and late-life pharmacological activation
records.note: Reviews CISD2 longevity and organ-health mechanisms and summarizes hesperetin-associated muscle transcriptomic and ageing benefits.
records.uncertainty: Known hesperetin route already primarily qualified; this review is not independent efficacy replication.

records.title: EWSR1 prevents the induction of aneuploidy through direct regulation of Aurora B.
records.model: Auxin-inducible EWSR1 degradation in DLD-1 cells and genetic replacement lines
records.note: EWSR1 loss displaced Aurora B and increased lagging chromosomes and aneuploidy; wild-type EWSR1 replacement rescued the phenotype but a low-Aurora-affinity mutant did not.
records.uncertainty: Auxin triggers engineered loss; it is not a rescue drug and no BUBR1-deficient cells are reported.

records.title: MPS1 promotes timely spindle bipolarization to prevent kinetochore-microtubule attachment errors in oocytes.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with MPS1 inhibition
records.note: MPS1 inhibition delayed spindle bipolarization until stable kinetochore attachments had formed, producing attachment errors.
records.uncertainty: No named compound or beneficial drug regimen appears in the saved abstract.

records.title: MYC prevents apoptosis and enhances endoreduplication induced by paclitaxel.
records.model: p53-mutant melanoma cells with altered MYC expression/activity
records.note: MYC overexpression permitted survival and endoreduplication during paclitaxel exposure, with reduced MAD2 and impaired checkpoint signaling.
records.uncertainty: Cancer-cell survival is associated with weakened fidelity, not normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: Aurora B prevents delayed DNA replication and premature mitotic exit by repressing p21(Cip1).
records.model: Conditional Aurora-B knockout cells, cultured fibroblasts and regenerating liver after hepatectomy
records.note: Aurora-B loss or inhibition delayed replication and promoted premature mitotic exit via p21; removing p21 restored Cdk1 activity and prevented premature exit.
records.uncertainty: The reported rescue is genetic p21 elimination, not an administered fidelity-restoring therapy.

records.title: Hypoxia Impairs Initial Outgrowth of Endothelial Colony Forming Cells and Reduces Their Proliferative and Sprouting Potential.
records.model: Human cord- and peripheral-blood endothelial colony-forming cells
records.note: Continuous hypoxia reduced initial colony outgrowth and later sprouting/proliferation; three days of prior oxygenation overcame the initial cord-cell outgrowth block.
records.uncertainty: Culture oxygen timing, not a small-molecule treatment or muscle functional result.

records.title: Clearance of Senescent Cells by BCL<sub>XL</sub>-PROTAC: A Novel Approach to Treat COPD?
records.model: COPD patient small-airway epithelial cells, fibroblasts and precision-cut lung slices; non-COPD cell comparison
records.note: The degrader induced caspase-3-associated death in senescent COPD cells, spared non-COPD cells, reduced senescence markers and increased proliferation; lung slices showed reduced epithelial p21.
records.uncertainty: Dose, exact chemical identity, tissue function and in vivo safety are absent; this extends the known senolytic route rather than showing BUB1B or muscle rescue.

records.title: Ablation of the spindle assembly checkpoint by a compound targeting Mps1.
records.model: Cultured cells and primary human cells with inhibitor-resistant Mps1 genetic control
records.note: SP600125 bypassed spindle-poison arrest by inhibiting Mps1 independently of JNK; an inhibitor-resistant Mps1 mutant restored checkpoint activity.
records.uncertainty: Relative resistance of primary cells is context-specific and is not a normal-tissue benefit or broad safety proof.

records.title: Maternal phosphatase inhibitor-2 is required for proper chromosome segregation and mitotic synchrony during Drosophila embryogenesis.
records.model: Drosophila maternal inhibitor-2 loss and transgenic replacement
records.note: Maternal inhibitor-2 loss caused segregation defects, asynchronous mitoses and poor embryonic survival; wild-type transgene dosage rescued hatch rate.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitor-2 is a protein name, not an administered phosphatase inhibitor.

records.title: A high throughput, whole cell screen for small molecule inhibitors of the mitotic spindle checkpoint identifies OM137, a novel Aurora kinase inhibitor.
records.model: Whole-cell checkpoint inhibitor screen and cultured-cell growth experiments
records.note: OM137 forced exit from spindle-poison arrest and inhibited growth at high concentration, potentiating subnanomolar paclitaxel.
records.uncertainty: A proposed cancer-selective window was the screen rationale; no restorative tissue benefit or validated normal-cell safety is reported.

records.title: Chemical genetic inhibition of Mps1 in stable human cell lines reveals novel aspects of Mps1 function in mitosis.

agent_roles.role: selective inhibition of engineered analog-sensitive Mps1

records.model: Human lines with endogenous Mps1 replaced by inhibitor-sensitive mutant
records.note: Timed Mps1 inhibition blocked attachment-error correction, Mad1 localization and checkpoint-complex formation; even brief inhibition killed cells.
records.uncertainty: Chemical-genetic sensitization is essential to this model; no therapeutic rescue is shown.

records.title: Griseofulvin stabilizes microtubule dynamics, activates p53 and inhibits the proliferation of MCF-7 cells synergistically with vinblastine.
records.model: Live MCF-7 breast cancer cells and purified tubulin assays
records.note: Griseofulvin dampened microtubule dynamics and caused misaligned or missegregated chromosomes and fragmented nuclei; it synergized with vinblastine to inhibit proliferation.
records.uncertainty: Microtubule stabilization here accompanies mitotic injury, not chromosome-fidelity or tissue rescue.

records.title: A cell-based assay for screening spindle checkpoint inhibitors.
records.model: Cell-based screen for exit from drug-induced mitotic arrest
records.note: Developed and validated an inexpensive cell assay to find compounds that override the spindle checkpoint.
records.uncertainty: No named new hit or normal-cell benefit is given.

records.title: Spindle checkpoint-independent inhibition of mitotic chromosome segregation by Drosophila Mps1.
records.model: Drosophila Mps1 overexpression with or without Mad2
records.note: Excess Mps1 delayed metaphase through Mad2 and impeded anaphase even without Mad2; experimentally resolving cohesion restored kinetochore movement.
records.uncertainty: Rescue manipulation is not a specified administered compound; increasing checkpoint activity can itself impair division.

records.title: Haspin inhibitors reveal centromeric functions of Aurora B in chromosome segregation.
records.model: Mitotic cells with Haspin inhibition and centromere-retargeted Aurora B
records.note: Haspin inhibition compromised alignment and checkpoint signaling by displacing Aurora B; centromeric retargeting partly restored signaling.
records.uncertainty: Genetic/localization rescue differs from beneficial drug administration; cytokinesis preservation is not complete fidelity safety.

records.title: p31(comet) inactivates the chemically induced Mad2-dependent spindle assembly checkpoint and leads to resistance to anti-mitotic drugs.
records.model: HeLa and other human cancer cells with p31-comet overexpression
records.note: p31-comet overexpression bypassed drug-induced checkpoint arrest and conferred resistance to nocodazole/taxol apoptosis; Eg5 blockade altered whether premature separation became aneuploidy.
records.uncertainty: Cancer drug resistance and a context lacking aneuploidy do not establish healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Dissecting the first and the second meiotic divisions using a marker-less drug-hypersensitive fission yeast.
records.model: Fission yeast engineered by deletion of seven multidrug-resistance genes
records.note: A drug-hypersensitive marker-free yeast strain enabled separate meiotic-stage perturbation and showed Aurora/Ark1 was needed for Bub1 kinetochore recruitment in both meiotic divisions.
records.uncertainty: Assay-enabling genetic sensitization, not a therapeutic intervention result.

records.title: Partial inhibition of Cdk1 in G 2 phase overrides the SAC and decouples mitotic events.

agent_roles.role: low-dose phosphatase inhibition rescuing induced defects

records.model: Cells exposed to graded Cdk1 inhibition from early G2
records.note: RO3306 uncoupled mitotic events and generated viable polyploid cells; low-dose okadaic acid increased completion of normal mitosis by restoring kinase/phosphatase balance.
records.uncertainty: Genuine pharmacological rescue of an induced Cdk1 imbalance; exact doses, cell type, chromosome fidelity and toxicity require primary verification, with no BUB1B model in the abstract.

records.title: Mitotic arrest and slippage induced by pharmacological inhibition of Polo-like kinase 1.
records.model: Cancer cell lines and primary non-transformed cells
records.note: Both Plk1 inhibitors arrested mitosis across doses but high concentrations promoted slippage with reduced Aurora-B and Cdk1 activity, despite no direct inhibition of SAC kinases.
records.uncertainty: Dose-dependent slippage occurred in the presence of normal-cell testing; no rescue benefit is established.

records.title: The mitotic checkpoint complex binds a second CDC20 to inhibit active APC/C.
records.model: Biochemical/cellular MCC-CDC20-APC/C checkpoint mechanism
records.note: The checkpoint complex bound a second APC/C-associated CDC20 to inhibit an already active APC/C, explaining rapid checkpoint reactivation.
records.uncertainty: No administered intervention or tissue benefit is reported.

records.title: A Simplified Strategy for Introducing Genetic Variants into Drosophila Compound Autosome Stocks.
records.model: Drosophila compound-autosome and balancer chromosome crosses
records.note: Balancer-based nonhomologous segregation improved genetic crossing yields and enabled compound-chromosome stocks with a meiotic mutation.
records.uncertainty: Genetic stock-construction method; no administered therapeutic result.

records.title: Characterisation of CCT271850, a selective, oral and potent MPS1 inhibitor, used to directly measure in vivo MPS1 inhibition vs therapeutic efficacy.

agent_roles.role: oral MPS1 inhibitor for cancer killing

records.model: Ninety-one cancer cell lines and colorectal-cancer xenograft models
records.note: CCT271850 abrogated the checkpoint, induced segregation without proper alignment and killed tumor cells; xenograft efficacy was moderate.
records.uncertainty: The estimate of over eighty percent inhibition for at least twenty-four hours is an efficacy prediction, not a normal-tissue safety or rescue threshold.

records.title: Implications of alternative routes to APC/C inhibition by the mitotic checkpoint complex.
records.model: Mathematical models of MCC, CDC20 and APC/C assembly
records.note: Alternative assembly pathways changed modeled checkpoint performance, with CDC20 funneling favoring inhibitory complex formation.
records.uncertainty: Predicted molecular strategies are not tested drugs or observed tissue benefits.

records.title: The p38α Stress Kinase Suppresses Aneuploidy Tolerance by Inhibiting Hif-1α.
records.model: p38-deficient cells with HIF-1alpha inhibition of unspecified modality
records.note: p38 loss increased glycolysis and survival after chromosome missegregation; HIF-1alpha inhibition restored apoptosis of the abnormal cells.
records.uncertainty: Lower aneuploid-cell persistence would reflect killing rather than corrected segregation; abstract does not identify an administered HIF inhibitor.

records.title: Molecular mechanisms of APC/C release from spindle assembly checkpoint inhibition by APC/C SUMOylation.
records.model: Reconstituted SUMOylated APC/C, cryo-EM and biochemical assays
records.note: APC4 SUMOylation repositioned APC2 and reduced checkpoint-complex affinity, allowing APC/C reactivation after checkpoint silencing.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacological rescue or organismal outcome is tested.

records.title: Skeletal muscle aging, cellular senescence, and senotherapeutics: Current knowledge and future directions.
records.model: Review of senescence and senotherapeutics in skeletal muscle ageing
records.note: Highlights limited knowledge of senescence in differentiated muscle fibers and resident cells while discussing potential effects on muscle mass, strength and function.
records.uncertainty: General preclinical senotherapeutic claims are not a named new muscle efficacy experiment.

records.title: Cellular Senescence in Sarcopenia: Possible Mechanisms and Therapeutic Potential.
records.model: Review of cellular senescence, muscle stem cells and sarcopenia
records.note: Surveys p53/p21 and p16 pathways, SASP and stem-cell dysfunction, including potentially beneficial senescence roles during repair.
records.uncertainty: No named administered intervention or quantitative functional result appears in the abstract.

records.title: ANAPHASE-PROMOTING COMPLEX/CYCLOSOME coactivators maintain AURORA 1 kinase homeostasis during meiotic chromosome segregation.
records.model: Arabidopsis APC/C coactivator mutants, ubiquitinome and AUR1 overexpression
records.note: AUR1 overexpression partly rescued cdc20.1 meiotic defects, while APC/C coactivators had opposing effects on AUR1 turnover.
records.uncertainty: Plant genetic rescue cannot establish a mammalian drug route.

records.title: Microvascular Health as a Key Determinant of Organismal Aging.
records.model: Review of vascular ageing and systemic age-associated disorders
records.note: Connects endothelial ageing to organ dysfunction and surveys pharmacological, genetic and lifestyle directions for vascular rejuvenation.
records.uncertainty: No named new administered agent or efficacy result is reported.

records.title: The Impact of Ageing on Skeletal Muscle: Roles of Mitochondrial Dysregulation, Systemic Communication, and Exercise.
records.model: Review of sarcopenia, mitochondrial dysfunction and exercise
records.note: Describes interacting muscle-cell, inflammatory, extracellular-matrix and neuromuscular mechanisms and the relevance of exercise.
records.uncertainty: No new drug efficacy experiment is specified.

records.title: CDC20 determines the sensitivity to spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC) inhibitors
records.model: Aneuploid cancer cells with CDC20 depletion; preprint
records.note: CDC20 depletion lengthened metaphase and reduced segregation errors and sensitivity to checkpoint inhibitors, linking excess CDC20 to aneuploid cancer vulnerability.
records.uncertainty: The error-reducing intervention is genetic depletion; no administered CDC20 inhibitor rescue is established.

records.title: Induction of robust de novo centrosome amplification, high-grade spindle multipolarity and metaphase catastrophe: a novel chemotherapeutic approach.
records.model: PC-3 prostate cancer cells
records.note: Red-Br-nos caused de novo centrosome amplification and multipolar death; tiron attenuated the multipolar phenotype, supporting a ROS contribution.
records.uncertainty: Tiron mitigates an induced cancer-cell injury; no normal-cell, muscle or BUB1B rescue is shown.

records.title: DNA damage-induced metaphase I arrest is mediated by the spindle assembly checkpoint and maternal age.
records.model: Young and aged mouse oocytes with DNA damage
records.note: DNA-damaged oocytes arrested in meiosis I through the SAC; inhibition overrode arrest, and aged oocytes had a compromised arrest response.
records.uncertainty: Progression after checkpoint inhibition does not show repaired DNA or improved gamete quality; injury agent and inhibitor are unnamed.

records.title: TRAIP is involved in chromosome alignment and SAC regulation in mouse oocyte meiosis.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with TRAIP knockdown or antibody inhibition
records.note: TRAIP loss increased DNA damage, misalignment and aneuploidy without preventing maturation, with reduced centromeric Mad2 and securin; antibody inhibition accelerated polar-body extrusion.
records.uncertainty: Completion of maturation here masks impaired quality; no rescue treatment is reported.

records.title: Maternal age-dependent APC/C-mediated decrease in securin causes premature sister chromatid separation in meiosis II.
records.model: Young and aged mouse oocytes; securin/Mps1 overexpression
records.note: Aged oocytes lost securin through increased APC/C destruction, and overexpressing securin or Mps1 protected cohesion and prevented premature sister separation.
records.uncertainty: The protective intervention is genetic; inhibition of Mps1 reproduces harm rather than rescue.

records.title: Mitotic motor CENP-E cooperates with PRC1 in temporal control of central spindle assembly.
records.model: Three-dimensional gastric organoids and two-dimensional mitotic-cell imaging
records.note: Syntelin disrupted PRC1 recruitment timing and central-spindle assembly; affinity capture identified the CENP-E–PRC1 interaction.
records.uncertainty: Affinity binding is not therapeutic efficacy, and the administered inhibitor impaired chromosome segregation.

records.title: The Long Noncoding RNA CCAT2 Induces Chromosomal Instability Through BOP1-AURKB Signaling.
records.model: CRC lines, CCAT2 transgenic mouse organoids/mice and over nine hundred patient tumors
records.note: CCAT2 increased BOP1 and Aurora-B activation, producing chromosome instability, drug resistance and more induced colon tumors; human expression correlated with poorer survival.
records.uncertainty: Potential pathway targeting is proposed, not an administered rescue; Aurora-B excess is a different context from BUBR1 insufficiency.

records.title: Compromised MPS1 Activity Induces Multipolar Spindle Formation in Oocytes From Aged Mares: Establishing the Horse as a Natural Animal Model to Study Age-Induced Oocyte Meiotic Spindle Instability.
records.model: In vitro matured oocytes from young and aged mares after spindle depolymerization
records.note: Aged mare oocytes were especially vulnerable to MPS1 inhibition during spindle reassembly; Aurora inhibition severely impaired spindle formation regardless of age.
records.uncertainty: This is harm counterevidence in a normal reproductive tissue context, not a compensatory inhibitor result.

records.title: Regulation of the Aurora-A gene following topoisomerase I inhibition: implication of the Myc transcription factor.
records.model: Colorectal cell lines with transcriptional and chromatin assays
records.note: SN38-associated topoisomerase-I inhibition reduced MYC/Aurora-A transcription, blocked centrosome separation and induced G2 arrest and senescence.
records.uncertainty: The proposed expression signature concerns cancer drug response; no healthy-tissue rescue is shown.

records.title: Premature senescence and increased TGFβ signaling in the absence of Tgif1.
records.model: Tgif1-null primary mouse embryonic fibroblasts and wild-type comparisons
records.note: A receptor kinase inhibitor increased proliferation in Tgif1-null fibroblasts; physiological oxygen partly reduced damage, while persistent low TGF-beta induced senescence in wild-type cells.
records.uncertainty: Exact inhibitor, restored genomic quality and tissue function are not specified; proliferation rescue alone does not establish healthy-cell repair.

records.title: Management of multicellular senescence and oxidative stress.
records.model: Review/hypothesis spanning oxidative stress, senescence and regenerative cells
records.note: Proposes adjusting stress-dependent death and survival programs to favor functional cells, drawing on senescent-cell clearance and regenerative biology.
records.uncertainty: The whole-organism strategy is hypothetical, without a new named administered efficacy experiment.

records.title: Caveolae control the anti-inflammatory phenotype of senescent endothelial cells.
records.model: Human endothelial cells with ARHGAP18 overexpression or caveolar-protein knockdown and caveolin-null mouse cells
records.note: Caveolae supported an anti-inflammatory senescent endothelial state; caveolar depletion reduced that population and reversed suppression of NF-kappaB signaling.
records.uncertainty: Fewer senescence markers can accompany loss of a beneficial anti-inflammatory state; no restorative drug is tested.

records.title: Comparison of mice with accelerated aging caused by distinct mechanisms.
records.model: Comparison of genetically accelerated-ageing mouse strains
records.note: Compares heterogeneous mechanisms and phenotypes of rapid-ageing models to identify appropriate uses and shared pathways.
records.uncertainty: A model-comparison review, not an administered intervention trial.

records.title: Integromics network meta-analysis on cardiac aging offers robust multi-layer modular signatures and reveals micronome synergism.
records.model: Integrated mouse/human cardiac-ageing expression and interaction datasets
records.note: Network meta-analysis defined forty consensus ageing modules and candidate microRNA combinations, with three modules reproducible by homology in humans.
records.uncertainty: Proposed multi-target therapy follows computational associations rather than administered efficacy.

records.title: Autophagy deficient keratinocytes display increased DNA damage, senescence and aberrant lipid composition after oxidative stress in vitro and in vivo.
records.model: Atg7-deficient mouse keratinocytes and skin, with paraquat or UVA stress
records.note: Autophagy loss amplified oxidative DNA injury, arrest and lipid dysregulation after paraquat or UVA, supporting a protective housekeeping role for Atg7.
records.uncertainty: mTOR inhibition is background motivation; no administered autophagy-restoring agent is tested.

records.title: Silencing of the small GTPase DIRAS3 induces cellular senescence in human white adipose stromal/progenitor cells.
records.model: Human adipose stromal/progenitor cells with DIRAS3 knockdown, including SCID-mouse grafts
records.note: DIRAS3 silencing activated Akt-mTOR and drove loss of proliferative/colony capacity, senescence markers and adipogenic differentiation.
records.uncertainty: Background claims about Akt-mTOR inhibitors are not drug rescue evidence in this experiment.

records.title: p21 maintains senescent cell viability under persistent DNA damage response by restraining JNK and caspase signaling.
records.model: DNA-damage-induced senescent cells and p21-knockout mouse liver fibrosis
records.note: p21 removal destabilized senescent-cell survival through DNA-damage, TNF and JNK/caspase signaling; knockout eliminated senescent stellate cells and reduced fibrosis.
records.uncertainty: Genetic p21 removal induces cell death rather than repaired senescent cells; no administered p21 inhibitor is established.

records.title: Identification of FDA-Approved Oncology Drugs with Selective Potency in High-Risk Childhood Ependymoma.
records.model: Two high-risk pediatric ependymoma lines versus other pediatric brain-tumor lines
records.note: Comparative drug screening identified fluoropyrimidines, retinoids and selected kinase inhibitors; axitinib reduced mitotic gene expression and induced senescence with PDGFR inhibition.
records.uncertainty: Selective cancer-cell potency is not normal-tissue rescue, and no BUB1B correction is reported.

records.title: Lipid accumulation facilitates mitotic slippage-induced adaptation to anti-mitotic drug treatment.

agent_roles.role: ACC inhibition enhancing post-slippage survival and inflammatory secretion
FASN inhibition reducing pro-tumor secretory effects

records.model: Cancer cells undergoing drug-induced mitotic slippage and paracrine recipient assays
records.note: TOFA accelerated slippage and increased surviving cells pro-tumor secretions, whereas C75 reduced secreted factors and downstream migration/invasion effects.
records.uncertainty: C75 is a senomorphic observation in a tumor-treatment context; neither lipid inhibitor is shown to restore normal-cell fidelity or muscle function.

records.title: Approaches towards Longevity: Reprogramming, Senolysis, and Improved Mitotic Competence as Anti-Aging Therapies.
records.model: Review comparing senolysis, reprogramming and mitotic competence
records.note: Proposes regulated improvement in mitotic competence as a way to delay senescence alongside senolysis and reprogramming.
records.uncertainty: A therapeutic hypothesis without a named new administered intervention result.

records.title: Hematopoietic PBX-interacting protein is a substrate and an inhibitor of the APC/C-Cdc20 complex and regulates mitosis by stabilizing cyclin B1.
records.model: HEK293T and HeLa cells with HPIP depletion and cell-cycle assays
records.note: HPIP transiently stabilized cyclin B1 as both APC/C substrate and inhibitor; its depletion caused multipolar spindles, chromosome abnormalities and failed cytokinesis.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic protein regulation without an administered rescue treatment.

records.title: Chemotherapy-induced cellular senescence suppresses progression of Notch-driven T-ALL.
records.model: Notch-driven T-ALL relapse mouse model with transgenic or pharmacological senescent-cell elimination
records.note: Eliminating doxorubicin-induced senescent cells revealed that these cells suppressed short-term tumor recurrence, contrasting with their longer-term host toxicity.
records.uncertainty: Specific senolytic regimen and tumor-versus-host cell contribution require primary text; this is context-specific counterevidence to indiscriminate senescence clearance.

records.title: Temporal Quantitative Proteomics Analysis of Neuroblastoma Cells Treated with Bovine Milk-Derived Extracellular Vesicles Highlights the Anti-Proliferative Properties of Milk-Derived Extracellular Vesicles.
records.model: Neuroblastoma cell cultures and temporal proteomics
records.note: Milk vesicles reduced proliferation and increased doxorubicin sensitivity, with enrichment of senescence/apoptosis-associated proteins and loss of growth/metabolic proteins.
records.uncertainty: Biological vesicle treatment induces tumor-cell suppression; no healthy tissue or muscle rescue is demonstrated.

records.title: Induction of Accelerated Aging in a Mouse Model.
records.model: Review of induced and genetic accelerated-ageing mouse models
records.note: Surveys commonly used and emerging rapid-ageing mouse models for mechanistic and translational experiments.
records.uncertainty: No named therapeutic efficacy result is provided.

records.title: Testicular aging, male fertility and beyond.
records.model: Review of testicular ageing and male fertility
records.note: Summarizes germ-cell and somatic-cell ageing mechanisms and discusses potential reproductive rescue directions.
records.uncertainty: No specific administered rescue experiment is given in the saved abstract.

records.title: A Glb1-2A-mCherry reporter monitors systemic aging and predicts lifespan in middle-aged mice.
records.model: Glb1-2A-mCherry reporter mice, including bleomycin lung injury
records.note: The reporter correlated with age and shorter survival, and dasatinib plus quercetin lowered the bleomycin-induced lung reporter signal.
records.uncertainty: Reduced marker signal is not reported functional recovery or an intervention-associated survival extension.

records.title: Accelerated cerebromicrovascular senescence contributes to cognitive decline in a mouse model of paclitaxel (Taxol)-induced chemobrain.

agent_roles.role: chemobrain-inducing exposure, 5 mg/kg/day in two five-day cycles
selective ablation trigger in p16-3MR engineered mice

records.model: p16-3MR mice, treatment three months after paclitaxel and outcomes six months after exposure
records.note: Both engineered-cell ablation and navitoclax reduced senescent endothelium and improved neurovascular coupling, barrier integrity, capillarization and cognitive performance after paclitaxel.
records.uncertainty: A real drug-associated functional rescue in toxin injury, extending the known senolytic class; navitoclax regimen, safety and transfer to muscle/BUB1B need primary verification.

records.title: Ercc1 DNA repair deficiency results in vascular aging characterized by VSMC phenotype switching, ECM remodeling, and an increased stress response.
records.model: Ercc1-deficient and age-matched mice, plus 104-week wild-type mice
records.note: Ercc1-deficient aortas showed cell loss, calcification, matrix remodeling and smooth-muscle contractile-to-osteogenic switching, supporting a vascular-ageing model.
records.uncertainty: The proposed drug-testing use is prospective; no administered treatment benefit is reported.

records.title: Characterisation of premature cell senescence in Alzheimer's disease using single nuclear transcriptomics.
records.model: Human Alzheimer and control postmortem brain imaging and more than two hundred thousand nuclei
records.note: Senescence-associated glial markers and stress programs increased with amyloid burden, while microglial phagocytosis programs declined.
records.uncertainty: Human association and replication across datasets do not demonstrate senolytic efficacy.

records.title: Integrative analysis of the transcriptome and metabolome reveals the importance of hepatokine FGF21 in liver aging.
records.model: Rat liver injury model, HepG2 cells and human liver/blood validation samples
records.note: FGF21 overexpression protected liver antioxidant and regenerative capacity in ageing models, following multi-omic evidence of reduced FGF21 and cell-cycle programs.
records.uncertainty: The reported rescue is overexpression; pharmacological maintenance of FGF21 is proposed without an administered agonist in the abstract.

records.title: Spatio-temporal control of mitosis using light via a Plk1 inhibitor caged for activity and cellular permeability.
records.model: Three-dimensional spheroid cultures exposed to a light uncaging pulse
records.note: Photocaging controlled inhibitor activity and cellular retention; a single light pulse arrested division through Plk1 inhibition.
records.uncertainty: Spatially controlled mitotic inhibition is a tool result, not evidence of restored fidelity or tissue health.

records.title: Transcriptomic profiling of senescence effects on blood-brain barrier-related gene expression in brain capillary endothelial cells in a mouse model of paclitaxel-induced chemobrain.

agent_roles.role: exposure represented in reanalyzed mouse dataset

records.model: Single-cell reanalysis of brain capillary endothelium from paclitaxel-treated and control mice
records.note: Senescent endothelial profiles showed reduced junction-assembly signals and increased matrix/inflammatory pathways consistent with barrier injury.
records.uncertainty: Senolytic restoration is cited prior work; this transcriptomic analysis is not an independent administered rescue experiment.

records.title: Kaempferol triggers cellular senescence via CDK1 ubiquitination in HCC cells.
records.model: HepG2 hepatocellular carcinoma cells plus public tumor datasets and docking
records.note: Kaempferol reduced CDK1 through ubiquitination and increased p16/p21 and beta-galactosidase senescence readouts, paralleling CDK1 knockdown.
records.uncertainty: Docking is computational and the cellular effect is senescence induction, not anti-ageing or normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: A Histone Code Functionally Linked to Replicative Senescence.
records.model: Replicatively senescent late-passage cells and histone-modification analysis
records.note: Inhibiting H3K79 trimethylation attenuated senescence-associated transcriptional upregulation; DOT1L and arginine-methylation regulators were implicated in cellular lifespan.
records.uncertainty: Agent identity, intervention-specific lifespan effect and retained genomic/function quality are absent; primary follow-up is needed before calling this a restorative drug route.

records.title: Universal transcriptomic hallmarks of mammalian ageing and mortality.
records.model: More than eleven thousand transcriptomes across four mammals and over twenty-five tissues
records.note: Cross-species ageing/mortality clocks identified shared and module-specific signatures and predicted responses to heterogeneous interventions.
records.uncertainty: Clock reversal and predicted lifespan response are not proof of a new administered treatment extending survival.

records.title: The YTHDC1-m<sup>6</sup>A-GADD45B axis promotes chondrogenesis of hPDLSCs via suppressing senescence through p53/p21 signalling pathway.
records.model: Human periodontal ligament stem cells and rat TMJ osteoarthritis transplantation
records.note: YTHDC1 overexpression reduced senescence and improved cartilage differentiation and rat disease phenotypes through m6A-dependent GADD45B decay.
records.uncertainty: Engineered-cell transplantation is the intervention; no small molecule or BUB1B rescue is tested.

records.title: Tetraploid state induces p53-dependent arrest of nontransformed mammalian cells in G1.
records.model: Nontransformed REF-52, NIH3T3 and IMR-90 cells with p53 comparisons
records.note: Cleavage failure produced p53-dependent G1 arrest; cells failing that arrest rapidly became aneuploid despite initially normal spindle segregation.
records.uncertainty: Proliferation after checkpoint loss can propagate damage rather than restore function; no beneficial drug is reported.

records.title: Identification of a MAD2-binding protein, CMT2, and its role in mitosis.
records.model: Human cells with CMT2 overexpression or depletion
records.note: Excess CMT2 bypassed spindle-checkpoint arrest and permitted mitotic exit without segregation, whereas depletion delayed anaphase and caused death.
records.uncertainty: Balanced checkpoint silencing is mechanistic; no administered therapeutic rescue appears.

records.title: Conformation-specific binding of p31(comet) antagonizes the function of Mad2 in the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: HeLa cells, isolated APC/C and Xenopus egg extracts
records.note: p31-comet bound closed Mad2 and restored APC/C activity without disrupting Mad2–CDC20 binding; its depletion delayed exit after nocodazole removal.
records.uncertainty: Biochemical activation and extract supplementation do not establish a therapeutic cell-fidelity rescue.

records.title: ZW10 links mitotic checkpoint signaling to the structural kinetochore.
records.model: Human mitotic cells and Xenopus egg extracts with ZW10-complex depletion
records.note: ZW10–Rod–Zwilch connected structural kinetochores to stable Mad1–Mad2 recruitment, defining a required checkpoint assembly link.
records.uncertainty: No administered intervention or rescue result is specified.

records.title: Coordinated requirements of human topo II and cohesin for metaphase centromere alignment under Mad2-dependent spindle checkpoint surveillance.
records.model: HeLa cells with cohesin/loading-factor RNAi and topoisomerase-II disruption
records.note: Topoisomerase-II inhibition aligned separated centromeres and permitted anaphase movements after cohesin depletion, plausibly through retained DNA catenations compensating tension.
records.uncertainty: Overriding delay and restoring alignment do not show faithful final segregation; accumulated catenations make this a weak therapeutic inference.

records.title: CENP-C is involved in chromosome segregation, mitotic checkpoint function, and kinetochore assembly.
records.model: Tetracycline-system conditional CENP-C knockout cell line
records.note: CENP-C loss reduced Mis12 recruitment and Mad2 checkpoint signals, allowing abnormal division or binucleation after delay and eventual cell death.
records.uncertainty: The inducible knockout is a genetic injury model; no restorative administered agent is reported.

records.title: The chromosomal passenger complex controls spindle checkpoint function independent from its role in correcting microtubule kinetochore interactions.
records.model: Cells with INCENP replaced by a coiled-coil-deletion mutant
records.note: The INCENP mutant restored alignment, syntelic correction and cytokinesis while failing taxol-induced checkpoint arrest, separating CPC error correction from checkpoint signaling.
records.uncertainty: A genetic separation-of-function result; alignment restoration alone does not establish checkpoint competence.

records.title: The kinetics of p53 activation versus cyclin E accumulation underlies the relationship between the spindle-assembly checkpoint and the postmitotic checkpoint.
records.model: Cells with checkpoint disruption, p53/p21 timing and cyclin-E manipulation
records.note: Premature exit allowed cyclin E to accumulate before p21 even with normal p53 activation kinetics, enabling DNA replication after slippage.
records.uncertainty: Accelerated cycling reflects checkpoint bypass, not repaired genome quality.

records.title: Caffeine yields aneuploidy through asymmetrical cell division caused by misalignment of chromosomes.
records.model: HeLa, U2OS and primary fibroblasts
records.note: Ten-millimolar caffeine delayed chromosome alignment and caused asymmetric division with surviving aneuploid progeny; MAD2 loss removed the delay.
records.uncertainty: The high experimental concentration cannot be extrapolated directly to ordinary consumption; bypassing delay did not demonstrate fidelity rescue.

records.title: Identification of Drosophila mitotic genes by combining co-expression analysis and RNA interference.
records.model: Drosophila tissue-culture RNAi screen of one thousand coexpressed genes
records.note: Detailed phenotyping identified one hundred forty-two mitotic genes, including newly implicated chromosome-breakage and spindle factors and a splicing–kinetochore connection.
records.uncertainty: Target discovery by RNAi is not an administered therapeutic result.

records.title: The DNA-damage effector checkpoint kinase 1 is essential for chromosome segregation and cytokinesis.
records.model: Chk1-haploinsufficient mouse mammary epithelium and mitotic mammalian cells
records.note: Chk1 reduction impaired cytokinesis, increased lagging/nondisjunction and mislocalized Aurora B, demonstrating normal mitotic functions beyond DNA-damage checkpoints.
records.uncertainty: No named beneficial drug or rescue intervention is specified; spindle-poison discussion is not therapeutic evidence.

records.title: CtBPs promote cell survival through the maintenance of mitotic fidelity.
records.model: Breast-cancer-derived cells with CtBP depletion and p53 comparisons
records.note: CtBP loss displaced Aurora B, produced segregation defects and reduced proliferation through arrest and apoptosis; p53 loss increased death susceptibility.
records.uncertainty: Cancer-cell killing after checkpoint-related injury is not a normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: The Aurora Kinase in Trypanosoma brucei plays distinctive roles in metaphase-anaphase transition and cytokinetic initiation.

agent_roles.role: timed inhibition of parasite Aurora-B homolog TbAUK1

records.model: Synchronized Trypanosoma brucei procyclic cells with live CPC tracking
records.note: VX-680 separated TbAUK1 requirements for metaphase progression and later cytokinesis initiation; effects depended on when the inhibitor was added.
records.uncertainty: Parasite cell-cycle dissection supplies no mammalian restoration or muscle-benefit evidence.

records.title: Bub3 is a spindle assembly checkpoint protein regulating chromosome segregation during mouse oocyte meiosis.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with Bub3 overexpression or RNAi, including cold-treatment attachment assays
records.note: Bub3 overexpression blocked meiotic transitions, whereas depletion caused misalignment, abnormal polar bodies and aneuploidy; both dosage directions altered division.
records.uncertainty: No administered rescue agent is shown, and increasing a checkpoint component is not uniformly beneficial.

records.title: CENPA overexpression promotes genome instability in pRb-depleted human cells.
records.model: HCT116 cells with pRb depletion, p53 knockout and CENPA RNAi
records.note: Restoring excessive CENP-A toward normal levels by RNAi reduced aneuploid-cell numbers after pRb loss despite an apparently retained poison-responsive checkpoint.
records.uncertainty: The corrective intervention is genetic dosage normalization, not an administered drug.

records.title: MAPK-activated protein kinase 2 is required for mouse meiotic spindle assembly and kinetochore-microtubule attachment.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with MK2 inhibition or knockdown and cold attachment testing
records.note: MK2 loss or inhibition destabilized kinetochore attachments and bipolar spindle organization and blocked homolog separation and meiotic progression.
records.uncertainty: No beneficial drug treatment is reported, and the inhibitor identity is absent.

records.title: A novel microtubule-modulating noscapinoid triggers apoptosis by inducing spindle multipolarity via centrosome amplification and declustering.

agent_roles.role: noscapinoid inducing centrosome amplification and cancer-cell death

records.model: Cultured tumor-cell mitosis with cell-cycle timing experiments
records.note: EM011 promoted centrosome amplification, declustering and multipolar mitoses; some surviving cells divided aberrantly and became aneuploid.
records.uncertainty: The background description as non-toxic does not override the measured mitotic harm or establish normal-muscle safety.

records.title: Evidence that Aurora B is implicated in spindle checkpoint signalling independently of error correction.
records.model: Cells with partial Mps1/Ndc80 or other checkpoint/kinetochore perturbation
records.note: Aurora-B inhibition synergized with partial checkpoint or kinetochore impairment to abolish spindle-poison arrest independently of attachment error correction.
records.uncertainty: Exact inhibitor identity and perturbation modalities require full text; result defines a harm boundary, not rescue.

records.title: Chromosomal instability in mouse embryonic fibroblasts null for the transcriptional co-repressor Ski.
records.model: Ski-null mouse embryonic fibroblasts with ectopic Ski restoration
records.note: Ski-null cells formed lagging chromosomes and micronuclei; restored Ski reduced micronucleated-cell numbers through increased mitotic death.
records.uncertainty: A reduction in abnormal cells reflected elimination rather than proven corrected segregation, and the intervention was genetic.

records.title: Formation of stable attachments between kinetochores and microtubules depends on the B56-PP2A phosphatase.

agent_roles.role: restoration of K-fibers after B56-PP2A depletion
restoration of K-fibers after B56-PP2A depletion

records.model: B56-PP2A-depleted mitotic cells
records.note: Phosphatase depletion destabilized attachments and increased Aurora/Plk1 substrate phosphorylation; inhibiting either kinase restored K-fibers.
records.uncertainty: Relevant kinase–phosphatase compensation, but abstract lacks drug identities/doses and faithful segregation or muscle endpoints; it does not state BUBR1 depletion.

records.title: APC15 drives the turnover of MCC-CDC20 to make the spindle assembly checkpoint responsive to kinetochore attachment.
records.model: APC15-loss experiments on APC/C-bound checkpoint complex turnover
records.note: Without APC15, checkpoint complexes and ubiquitinated CDC20 remained bound to APC/C and prevented cyclin-B1 degradation after attachment satisfaction.
records.uncertainty: No administered rescue therapy is reported.

records.title: Cdk1 promotes kinetochore bi-orientation and regulates Cdc20 expression during recovery from spindle checkpoint arrest.
records.model: Yeast recovery from spindle-checkpoint arrest
records.note: Cdk1 promoted attachment biorientation by limiting premature spindle elongation and sustained CDC20 expression during checkpoint recovery.
records.uncertainty: Therapeutic implications are inferred from mechanism; no named restorative drug experiment appears.

records.title: APC/C-Cdh1-dependent anaphase and telophase progression during mitotic slippage.
records.model: Yeast bub2-deletion mutants with precocious APC/C-Cdh1 activity
records.note: Premature APC/C-Cdh1 activation drove cohesin cleavage, chromosome missegregation and exit despite active SAC signaling.
records.uncertainty: Proposed Cdh1 inhibition for cancer therapy is not a tested administered rescue.

records.title: Bloom's syndrome and PICH helicases cooperate with topoisomerase IIα in centromere disjunction before anaphase.

agent_roles.role: comparison associated with excess ultrafine bridges

records.model: BLM- or PICH-deficient prometaphase cells with centromere imaging/biochemistry
records.note: BLM and PICH supported centromeric topoisomerase-IIalpha recruitment and decatenation; their loss left nondisjunction-prone centromeres and extra ultrafine bridges.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitor-associated bridge formation supports a harm mechanism; no therapeutic rescue agent is specified.

records.title: Mitotic Kinases and p53 Signaling.
records.model: Review of mitotic kinases and p53 signaling in cancer
records.note: Summarizes reciprocal p53–kinase regulation and challenges in therapeutic inhibition of mitotic kinases.
records.uncertainty: No new administered rescue experiment or tissue-function benefit is presented.

records.title: The MRN-CtIP pathway is required for metaphase chromosome alignment.
records.model: Xenopus egg extracts, DNA-coated beads and mammalian cells
records.note: Mirin and MRN/CtIP depletion impaired RCC1 chromosome association, Ran signaling and spindle/alignment function.
records.uncertainty: The inhibitor creates defects and offers no restorative evidence.

records.title: Chk1-Mad2 interaction: a crosslink between the DNA damage checkpoint and the mitotic spindle checkpoint.

agent_roles.role: Chk1 inhibition reducing Mad2 in sensitive tumor cells

records.model: Tumor cells with Chk1 RNAi/drug inhibition and in vitro Mad2 phosphorylation assays
records.note: Chk1 inhibition lowered Mad2 in sensitive tumor cells; mapping and interaction assays supported direct Chk1–Mad2 crosstalk.
records.uncertainty: No drug-associated restoration is reported and the effect is restricted to responsive tumor contexts.

records.title: Replication stress and mitotic dysfunction in cells expressing simian virus 40 large T antigen.
records.model: Inducible SV40 large-T-antigen cells with Bub1-binding comparisons
records.note: Large T induced Bub1-dependent attachment defects and replication-stress signaling before mitotic injury; nucleoside supplementation attenuated replication-stress signatures.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not establish rescued final segregation, cell function or a BUB1B-deficient model; composition and regimen require primary verification.

records.title: NudC deacetylation regulates mitotic progression.
records.model: NudC/HDAC3-depleted mitotic cells and acetylation-mutant complementation
records.note: Wild-type or deacetylation-mimetic NudC rescued alignment/segregation defects, whereas an acetylation mimic failed; HDAC3 inhibition increased NudC acetylation.
records.uncertainty: The rescue is genetic and HDAC3 loss is deleterious; this cannot be generalized to benefit from all HDAC inhibitors.

records.title: Cdk1 inactivation terminates mitotic checkpoint surveillance and stabilizes kinetochore attachments in anaphase.
records.model: Human cells with cyclin-B1 stabilization and acute Cdk1 inhibition
records.note: Cyclin-B1 persistence reactivated attachment surveillance in anaphase, while Cdk1 inhibition prevented checkpoint establishment and maintenance after depolymerization.
records.uncertainty: Normal timing of checkpoint termination is explained; pharmacological bypass is not demonstrated fidelity repair.

records.title: TAO1 kinase maintains chromosomal stability by facilitating proper congression of chromosomes.
records.model: TAO1-depleted human cells with microtubule-dynamics and error-correction assays
records.note: TAO1 loss reduced growing microtubule density and impaired congression and attachment correction, generating aneuploidy.
records.uncertainty: No named administered rescue is described despite use of drug probes.

records.title: Thyroid hormone receptor interacting protein 13 (TRIP13) AAA-ATPase is a novel mitotic checkpoint-silencing protein.
records.model: TRIP13 knockdown/ATPase interference and checkpoint-complex assays
records.note: TRIP13 activity was needed for p31-comet-mediated checkpoint silencing, and loss prolonged MCC-bound APC/C inhibition and metaphase.
records.uncertainty: Proposed cancer effects of overexpression do not establish an administered treatment result.

records.title: A Golgi-localized pool of the mitotic checkpoint component Mad1 controls integrin secretion and cell migration.
records.model: Mad1-depleted or overexpressing cells with Golgi secretion and motility assays
records.note: A Mad2-independent Golgi pool of Mad1 supported integrin secretion, adhesion and directed migration, separate from its checkpoint role.
records.uncertainty: Manipulating checkpoint genes has nonmitotic consequences; no therapeutic agent or rescue test is reported.

records.title: DNA damage response and spindle assembly checkpoint function throughout the cell cycle to ensure genomic integrity.
records.model: C. elegans germ cells and human replication-perturbation observations
records.note: DDR kinases and SAC components jointly sustained metaphase and DNA repair, with MAD/CENPA-dependent localization of damaged chromatin to the nuclear periphery.
records.uncertainty: No named administered restorative intervention appears; CDC20-checkpoint interactions do not capture all repair roles.

coverage_limit: Only these120 complete saved abstracts were read in this task. This is not review of all419 ranking candidates, all5902 outer records, or full texts.
review_method: Read every complete saved abstract sequentially in twelve batches of ten, then authored original per-record appraisals and persisted each batch. Only known HTML formatting tags were removed for display; hashes use the exact raw saved abstractText.
